name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Cherry Mango
description: Take your taste buds somewhere tropical with Double-Stacked Cherry Mango BITEZ. Two vibrant layers combine tart, juicy cherry with ripe, tropical mango for a sweet-and-tangy flavor that delivers a burst of fruit with every chew. Each double-stacked gummy packs a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total). A tropical fruit fusion stacked with serious potency.
